acceptance: RED first: a seeded defect whose file and line range are absent from the judge report counts as missed
JQ1 reports per judge and per defect class with Wilson bounds
JQ3 reads the structured severity block when present and the pattern otherwise, and a line 'HIGH 0' never counts
JQ4 on a fixture with 3 audit calls on claude-tmux and 1 on another family gives 0.25
A test fails when a corpus file path appears in any resolved phase prompt of a fixture cycle
JQ1 defaults to stage shadow; JQ3 and JQ4 default to report

The calibration report gives the cross-family agreement rate for each judge seat, from repeated runs on the seeded corpus. A seat under 90 percent agreement reopens self-consistency (operator decision 2026-11-03, AD3-3).
fix: Build a seeded-defect corpus from past real defects re-applied to a frozen tree, each with its class and expected finding. Run each judge through evolve agent run (ADR-0152) at --scope judges and compute JQ1 per judge and class. Add a structured severity block to the review files so that JQ3 stops depending on a pattern. Compute JQ4 from llm-calls.ndjson and the family map of the routing table.
summary: The independent review finds a HIGH or CRITICAL defect on 41.8% [32.6, 51.7] of 98 PRs, counted by a pattern over free text. All 234 audit calls ran on claude-tmux. No measure shows how often a judge finds a known defect. Spec: docs/architecture/llm-quality-indexes.md §9 JQ1, JQ3 and JQ4. Needs evolve agent run (ADR-0152), which is on main.
title: Quality indexes Q8: seeded-defect recall of the judges, structured review severity and judge family diversity
